channel.title: CFA Level I Audio Review
channel.description: Original 30 minute review episodes for the November 2026 CFA Level I exam, in Kaplan Schweser module order. Each episode teaches the core ideas, traps and formulas for a group of modules and ends with a spoken recall check. Not produced by or affiliated with Kaplan or CFA Institute.
